final:
type Bad = { n: int }

check(x: int) -> int fail Bad =
  if x % 2 == 1
    fail Bad(n: x)
  x

all_even(xs: List[int]) -> List[int] fail Bad =
  post out.len() == xs.len()
  ex all_even([]) == []
  ex all_even([2, 4, 6]) == [2, 4, 6]
  let ys = par for x in xs
    check(x)?
  ys
